method: Source glyph fills against topmost full-page fill followed by smallest containing filled local rectangular background or verified page-6 ellipse, all corners inside. Diagram curves classified visually. Rendered background RGB must occur within two pixels of glyph box (tolerance 2/255). All text conservatively tested at 4.5, without large-text exception. No images in PDF.
limitations: Not PDF/UA, screen reader, semantic or reading-order validation. Decorative outlines considered separately.
